description:
Metadata for one candidate: why it exists, what it's derived from (if
anything), and what/who asked for it.

base_version.description: source_path's Windmill script hash at the time of derivation — lets a later promotion check detect the base has since changed (stale-base conflict, HF-013). Required whenever source_path is set.
base_version.title: Base Version

generated_by_capability.description: Capability path that generated this candidate's content, if an AI capability (HF-019) produced it rather than a human.
generated_by_capability.title: Generated By Capability

source_path.description: Active capability path this candidate was derived from, if any.
source_path.title: Source Path

title: CandidateRecord
